thread:
incident-bot: Pager — kv-cache: continuous-batching growth anomaly detected in prod-us-west. paging-rate ↑4.2x, tail latency ↑3.8x. Triggered autoscaler cascading. AlertID: KV-BATCH-231654.

lee-nguyen: oncall (eng-runtime) taking this. pinging SRE and infra.

maria-k: looking at dashboards now — batch_window p50->p95 shift, most requests are small but batching keeps growing. link: https://dash.redwood/kv/batch/231654 (internal)

aj: any customer reports?

cs-anne: AtlasPay reported intermittent 5xxs (~15% requests) starting ~10m ago. Support routed logs to engineering.

sre-pat: seeing KV page-ins per-shard spike, memory working_set up, evictions thrashing. Looks like continuous batching + a long-tail of huge sequences causing cache blowups for some shards.

lee-nguyen: hypothesis — default batch window got widened in last config push (batch.window.ms 200 -> 400) plus new micro-optimizations. Together allowed batches to grow and create KV pressure. Need immediate mitigation: reduce batch.window.ms and enable per-tenant overrides for high-throughput customers.

maria-k: I can roll a hotfix flag to soft-cap batch size and reduce window. Proposed quick patch: set batch.window.ms=120 and batch.max_items_softcap=64. Apply canary 10% traffic first.

aj: 👍 do it. Prepare rollback plan if errors spike.

lee-nguyen: commands I'll run (internal flag service):
```bash
# set canary: 10% of prod hosts
curl -XPOST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \
  https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/batch.window.override \
  -d '{"value":120, "target":"canary", "percent":10}'
# set softcap
curl -XPOST https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/batch.max_items_softcap -d '{"value":64, "target":"canary", "percent":10}'
```

deploy-bot: feature-flag update accepted: batch.window.override -> 120 (canary 10%) by lee-nguyen. job-id: ff-231654-1

sre-pat: monitoring canary now. watch memory, page-ins, and 5xxs for AtlasPay.

maria-k: initial canary metrics (5m after change): canary hosts tail latency -38%, paging-rate -45% vs baseline. error rate stable.

cs-anne: AtlasPay 5xxs dropping in reported logs — they confirm fewer errors in last 6m.

aj: good sign. Ramp to 50% but hold per-tenant override plan ready.

lee-nguyen: ramping to 50% now. command: `curl ... -d '{"percent":50}'` (omitted).

deploy-bot: feature-flag update accepted: batch.window.override -> 120 (canary 50%) job-id ff-231654-2

sre-pat: across 50% hosts: tail latency -34% overall, paging down 30%. No new errors. Memory pressure subsiding on affected shards.

maria-k: I'll push per-tenant override for AtlasPay to immediately cap them at batch.max_items_softcap=32 until we complete root-cause. Doing via admin: `Flags > Overrides > tenant:atlaspay`

lee-nguyen: per-tenant override applied for atlaspay: batch.max_items_softcap=32. Confirming: AtlasPay traffic pinned to override on 4 ingress nodes.

cs-anne: AtlasPay reports full recovery (no 5xxs). They've been notified to expect a maintenance window for durable fix.

aj: good. Next: create follow-up ticket for config audit and revert the larger window at source. Also schedule a postmortem to confirm why the two changes combined caused amplification.

lee-nguyen: follow-up issues created: ENG-10234 (postmortem), ENG-10235 (config gating + tests), ENG-10236 (better per-tenant throttling).

sre-pat: closing immediate incident — mitigation stable for 25m. Leaving flags at 50% ramp for 15m then full rollout if no regressions. Rollback plan: re-run flags to previous values (batch.window.ms=400) if errors increase > 5% or paging-rate returns.

maria-k: will monitor logs and perf dashboards for next 2 hours. Also attaching quicknotes in the ticket about test coverage gaps and recommend a preflight canary on batch config changes.

lee-nguyen: TL;DR — hotfix: soft-cap + reduced window, canary -> 10% -> 50%, per-tenant override for AtlasPay, metrics recovered, follow-up tickets created.

deploy-bot: Canary fully stable. scheduled auto-rollout to 100% in 30m unless cancelled.

lee-nguyen: incident resolved for now. If anyone sees anomalies, ping me directly. Closing thread in 1h after final check. :white_check_mark:

cs-anne: Thanks team — I'll follow up with AtlasPay CS note and keep them in the loop. :thumbsup:

// End of thread
